description:
Found 2026-08-13 while scoping op-j2oq. This is the sibling-crate counterpart of op-1fyp, and it was never filed.

THE DEFECT. crates/tampines-steam-tables/src/openfoam_algorithms/rhoPimpleFoam/mod.rs:1639

    let conv_he = fvc::div(&self.phi, &self.he);   // explicit div(phi h)/V

fvc::div interpolates the convected scalar with fvc::interpolate, i.e. LINEAR (central) interpolation, unlimited.
The energy equation is advection-dominated (cell Peclet >> 1), so an advancing thermal front carries dispersive
over- and undershoots. That is verbatim the symptom op-1fyp records -- for OPCPFluidArray.

THE ASYMMETRY. The coolprop sibling was FIXED: crates/outram-park-fork-coolprop/.../rhoPimpleFoam/mod.rs:1306 now
calls fvc::div_limited with an EnergyConvectionScheme limiter enum (:276, VanLeer default / Minmod / Upwind /
Linear), and its comment cites op-1fyp. TampinesSteamArray never received the same treatment. Momentum in BOTH
files is already implicit (fvm::div_vec at :1351 and :986 respectively) -- only the energy side differs.

This is exactly the failure mode the root CLAUDE.md warns about: 'Ports often exist in pairs; a defect or a feature
in one usually has a counterpart in the other.' A fix was applied to one lineage and its twin was left behind.

DO NOT CONFUSE with the OTHER limiter in the same file. Line 2203 does use fvc::Limiter::VanLeer, but that is the
central-upwind (Kurganov-Tadmor) reconstruct_pos_neg path for rho/he/p/c -- a DIFFERENT solver path, not the PIMPLE
energy equation. So the array is limited in one path and unlimited in the other, which is worth resolving
deliberately rather than by accident.

SUGGESTED FIX: mirror the coolprop treatment -- an EnergyConvectionScheme-equivalent limiter enum and
fvc::div_limited. Whether it should also gain the implicit mode being built for OPCPFluidArray under op-j2oq is a
separate decision; the maintainer deliberately stopped an agent that was starting that work here, so do not assume it.

Consider whether op-1fyp should be widened to cover both arrays, or this kept separate and both closed together.
title: TampinesSteamArray energy convection is unlimited central differencing -- the op-1fyp defect, never filed for this array
